name: In Plain Sight 2
desc:
Smile, your death will be on camera.

🔨 New update is out now! Admin commands gamepass and more!

In Plain Sight 2 is a game all about stealing! Play as a thief to take as many items as you can, or work as a camera to shut down this crime wave. Use your cash to purchase new thief characters with special abilities or state-of-the-art camera technology that'll help clean these streets.

💰 Saturdays and Sundays (in UTC-5) have 25% discounts in the thief and camera shops!
